bank.name: State Bank of India
bank.period: Year ended 31 March 2026 · Compared with the previous financial year
bank.summary: Three changes worth understanding. Each tells us something different about the bank.

insights.title: Loans grew faster than deposits
insights.meaning: Lending growth outpaced deposit growth. It raises a question about how the bank funded the difference; it does not prove a cash shortage.
insights.watch: The cost of new deposits, other borrowing and cash available for lending.

insights.title: The bank kept less interest per rupee
insights.meaning: For every ₹100 of assets that earn interest, the bank kept about ₹2.91 in interest after funding costs. This is before other costs and losses.
insights.watch: Whether interest earned on loans and interest paid for funding change at different speeds.

insights.title: A smaller remaining problem-loan share
insights.meaning: This measures problem loans after deducting reserves, relative to loans after reserves. A lower share does not prove that every borrower is safer.
insights.watch: New missed repayments, loans written off and reserves set aside for possible losses.

bank.company_note: Official SBI FY2026 standalone figures. Other company tabs retain the older profile snapshot.

flow.title: People deposit money
flow.text: Customer deposits are one source of funding.

flow.title: The bank lends money
flow.text: Loans earn interest. Deposits and borrowing have a cost.

flow.title: The difference helps fund the business
flow.text: The bank still pays operating costs and allows for loan losses.

context.title: Interest rates
context.text: They can change what the bank earns on loans and what it pays for funding. These sides may change at different speeds.

context.title: The economy
context.text: Customers’ demand for loans and ability to repay can change. We have not connected a verified economic-activity dataset yet.

context.title: Bond yields
context.text: Changes can affect securities the bank already holds and the income it earns from new investments. We do not yet know SBI’s full exposure.

bank.quality_notice: One historical income comparison is paused because two official SBI sources disagree. The three explanations above use separate figures.
bank.limitation: This is annual history, not today’s news. We can explain possible paths; we cannot yet measure a new event’s effect on SBI.
